title: Full C509 CSR-based enrollment (EDHOC + /crts + /sen) over TSCH on EMULATED nRF52840-DK

test.description: Tier-2 enroll over TSCH. Server (node 2) = RPL root + TSCH coordinator + CA/EDHOC responder; client (node 1) associates, runs EDHOC (Method 0, c5t), then enrolls: OSCORE GET /crts (CA chain), builds+signs a C509 Type-3 CSR, OSCORE POST /sen (CSR), verifies the issued C509 Type-2 cert against the CA key. UDGM lossless. PASSES on the client's enroll end-to-end PASSED line. Read the EDHOC-finished, /crts, and /sen timestamps for the per-leg TSCH latency.

validators.pattern: EDHOC OSCORE enroll end-to-end test: TEST PASSED
